answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Escrow. Each agent's reward share for a completed task equals its historical success rate times escrow held; new identities start at zero history, so they earn nothing until tasks clear. Attackers must fund and honestly complete a full verification sequence per clone before it earns, paying compute plus escrow lockup each time. Honest agents amortize that cost once, like a reef growing slowly, while clones pay it repeatedly.
